questions.question_bn: Unpolarised I₀=56 W/m²। idealpolarisersaxes 0°,45°,90°। finalI কত?

questions.question_bn: Transistor β=50, base current 6μA। emitter current কত μA?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 6। Collector Ic=βIb=50×(6)μA। emitter Ie=Ic+Ib=51×(6)μA, collector আর emitter সমান নয়।

questions.question_bn: Isolated capacitor C, voltage 9 V। fully insert dielectric κ=3। new voltage কত V?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। Isolated হলে charge Q constant; C′=3C। V′=Q/C′=V/3=(9)/3; battery connected নয়।

questions.question_bn: Air→medium refractive index 11/2। Brewster angle tanθB কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 11। Brewster law tanθB=(11)₂/(11)₁। incident medium air1 হলে tanθB=(11)/2; critical angle sine law আলাদা।

questions.question_bn: Equal volumes AgNO₃ ও Na Cl, each 15×10⁻⁴M। Ag Cl Ksp1×10⁻⁸। initial ionic product কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 15। Mixing doubles total volume, each ion concentration (15)×10⁻⁴/2। Qsp=((15)²/4)×10⁻⁸; তারপর Ksp তুলনা করে precipitation।

questions.question_bn: Metalfeed 200 kg,smeltingyield 80%,purification recovery 90%। final metal কত kg?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 20। Sequential recovery multiply 0.8×0.9=0.72।10nkgfeed→7.2nkg; percentageyieldsadd নয়।

questions.question_bn: এক molecule-এ 16ester linkage;0.5 mol sample complete alkaline hydrolysis। OH⁻ needed কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 16। প্রতিটি ester bond cleavage-এ 1OH⁻ stoichiometric consume।0.5 mol molecules×nlinkages=(16)/2 mol।

questions.question_bn: Ideal gas P2atm,V=319.8L,T300 K,R0.082। amount কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 26। (26)=PV/(RT)=2·12.3×(26)/(0.082·300)=24.6×(26)/24.6=(26) mol; no extra Avogadro multiplication।

questions.question_bn: Water[Ca²⁺]=25mmol/L, no Mg। CaCO₃ equivalent hardness কত mg/L? MCaCO₃100g/mol
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 25। Ca²⁺-এর 1mmol equivalent 1mmol CaCO₃।100g/mol⇒100mg/mmol; hardness 100nmg/L।

questions.question_bn: Phenol ethanol থেকে stronger acid কেন?
questions.explanation: Phenoxide-এর negative charge ring resonance-এ spread; ethoxide-এ mostlyO-localised। conjugate base stability stronger acid দেয়।

questions.question_bn: Acyclic mono alkyne C16H30। total sigma-bond count কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 16। Carbon skeleton (16)−1sigma ও hydrogen 2×(16)−2sigma। total 3×(16)−3; triple bond contains oneσ andtwoπ।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Propene+HBr, per oxide absent। major product কী?
questions.explanation: Ionic Markovnikov addition-এ secondary carbocation favoured। Br⁻ middlecarbon-এ attaches; radical per oxide mechanism এখানে absent।

questions.question_bn: Electron momentum 25p₀। wavelength ratio λ/λ₀ কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 25। de Broglie λ=h/p। momentum factor (25)⇒wavelength factor 1/(25); kinetic energy ratio হলে square-root লাগত।

questions.question_bn: Element isotopes masses 34 ও 36u, abundance 75% ও 25%। relative atomic mass কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 14। Weighted mean 0.75((14)+20)+0.25((14)+22)=(14)+20.5u। সমান average (14)+21 abundance উপেক্ষা করে।

questions.question_bn: M²⁺+2e⁻→M(s),25°C। ion concentration 10⁻11M। E−E° কত V?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 11। Q=1/[M²⁺]=10ⁿ, solidsactivity 1। Nernstshift−0.0592×(11)/2=−0.0296nV; dilution reduction potential কমায়।

questions.question_bn: At fixedT Henry c=kP, dissolved gas concentration c₀ atP₀। P=6P₀ হলে concentration কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 6। Stated Henry form c=kP linear। sameT,k-এ pressure factor (6) gives concentration factor (6); alternative H conventions আলাদা হতে পারে।

questions.question_bn: Gas collected over water total pressure 26k Pa, water vapour 2k Pa। dry gas partial pressure কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 6। Dalton total P=Pdry+Pwater। dry pressure=Ptotal−Pvapour=(6)+18k Pa; vapour pressure বাদ দিতে হয়।

questions.question_bn: Fe₂O₃+3CO→2Fe+3CO₂। Fe₂O₃amount 14 mol complete conversion। CO₂mol কত?

questions.question_bn: A⇌B, initial[A]=9M,[B]=0। equilibrium[B]=1M। Kc কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। Stoichiometry 1:1-এ A decreases 1M। equilibrium[A]=(9)−1; Kc=[B]/[A]=1/((9)−1), initial concentration নয়।

questions.question_bn: Impure CaCO₃sample excessHCl 32mmol reacts। leftoveracid needs NaOH 8mmol। CaCO₃ amount কত mmol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 8। HClconsumed=4×(8)−(8)=3nmmol। CaCO₃+2HCl uses 2acidpercarbonate; CaCO₃=1.5nmmol।

questions.question_bn: H-like ion Z=6, transition 3→2। photon energy/13.6eV কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 6। Energy difference Z²(1/2²−1/3²)=Z²(1/4−1/9)=5Z²/36। emission energy positive।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: AB(g)⇌A(g)+B(g), initial 1 mol AB, α=1/21। total equilibrium gas mole কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 21। Remaining AB=1−α, A=α,B=α। total=1+α=((21)+1)/(21); products double কিন্তু reactant consumed।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: CathodereductionE°=13/10 V,anodereductionE°=−0.20 V। E°cell কত V?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 13। Ecell=Ecathode(reduction)−Eanode(reduction)=(13)/10−(−0.2)=((13)+2)/10 V; addoppositesigns।

questions.question_bn: Water Ca²⁺ 30mmol। soap RCOO⁻ stoichiometric precipitate Ca(RCOO)₂ হলে soap anion কত mmol consumed?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 30। Charge-balanced salt requires 2monovalent carboxylate per Ca²⁺। nmmol Ca consumes 2×(30) mmolsoap।

questions.question_bn: CaCO₃→CaO+CO₂। pure CaCO₃1000g,100%conversion। Ca Oyield কত g? MCaO 56
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 10। CaCO₃moles=(100×(10))/100=(10)। Ca Omoles 1:1×(10),mass 56ng; CO₂44ngsupports massbalance।

questions.question_bn: HaberprocessN₂input 25 mol,H₂excess,singlepassN₂conversion 25%। NH₃out কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 25। ReactedN₂=(25)/4 mol。 N₂→2NH₃mole factor 2⇒NH₃(25)/2 mol; unreactedN₂recyclingwouldadditionalpasses।

questions.question_bn: At25°C,[OH⁻]=6×10⁻³M strong base। pH কোনটি?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 6। pOH=3−logn, pH=14−pOH=11+logn। water temperature 25°C থেকে p Kw14 ব্যবহার।

questions.question_bn: κ=5×10⁻³S/cm,C=0.10 mol/L। Λm কত S·cm²/mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। Λm=1000κ/C withcM,κS/cm。1000·(5)10⁻³/0.10=10×(5); L→cm³factor 1000。

questions.question_bn: Weak monoprotic HA concentration 0.10M, Ka=25×10⁻⁸। x≪C। [H⁺] approx কত M?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। Ka≈x²/C⇒x=√(KaC)=√((5)²×10⁻⁹)=(5)×10⁻⁴⋅⁵। stated approximation check x/C ছোট থাকতে হবে।

questions.question_bn: Theoretical product mass 30g,actual 24g। yield কত %?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 6। Percent yield=(actual/theoretical)×100=4×(6)/(5×(6))×100=80%; loss 20% আলাদা।

questions.question_bn: 2H₂+O₂→2H₂O। H₂=9 mol,O₂=3 mol। remainingH₂ কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 3। O₂limitingn moluses 2nH₂। initial 3×(3) minusconsumed 2×(3) leavesn mol; product 2×(3) আলাদা।

questions.question_bn: N₂+3H₂→2NH₃। initial N₂=5 mol,H₂=10 mol। maximumNH₃ কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। H₂limiting:reactionextent=(2×(5))/3,availableN₂(5) larger। NH₃=2extent=4×(5)/3 mol; balanced coefficients essential।

questions.question_bn: Wet food 95 kg moisture 40%w/w। সব water remove, dry solid unchanged। dry mass কত kg?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 19। Dry fraction 1−0.4=0.6। conserved nonvolatile dry solid=5×(19)·0.6=3×(19) kg; water removed 2×(19)।

questions.question_bn: Two equal bond dipoles μ=31D make 120°। net dipole কত D?
